snippet.title: Cottonville Nintendo Trailer IndieMania 2025
snippet.description:
Create, farm, and style in Cottonville – a cozy dress-up game with farming and sim mechanics! 
From planting seeds to sewing stylish outfits, every day is a mix of creativity and farming fun. Run your atelier, make unique outfits using sewing patterns, and dress up customers based on their requests. Customize your character, try out different styles, and bring your fashion dreams to life. It’s time to grow your way to success!
Escape to Cottonville
A friend’s unexpected offer of a new life in Cottonville might be just what you need. Far from the noise of Friglight, a small family sewing shop is waiting for you in this peaceful town. Cottonville offers a cozy escape where you can start fresh and build your career, one stitch at a time, while letting the drama of the big city fade away.
Customize Your Character
Make your character truly yours! Choose hairstyles, eyes, skin, and more alongside the outfits that match your style. As you progress, unlock new fashion items and expand your wardrobe to reflect your journey in Cottonville.
Fashion Career Starts on the Farm
Whether you’re growing crops or crafting trendy outfits, Cottonville combines the simple joys of farm life with the excitement of fashion design. You’ll learn everything from fabric-making to fashion styling – right from the farm!
Grow and harvest essential crops like cotton, linen, and bamboo, and gather flowers for natural dyes to produce fabrics – all available in seven different colors. Buy new sewing patterns to expand your dress-up options and make even more fashionable clothes. Your farm provides everything needed to craft stylish outfits.
Run Your Atelier
Your atelier is the heart of Cottonville’s fashion world! With over 60 clothing designs and multiple color variations, you can sew, dye, and customize garments using a set collection of sewing patterns to match your customers' needs. Listen to their requests, mix and match fabrics, and create outfits that suit their personalities.
Every customer has a story, and your designs help them shine. Whether it’s a fancy dress for a festival, a warm sweater for winter, or a breezy outfit for summer, your boutique becomes the town’s go-to fashion hub.

The game includes:
Over 60 patterns with different color options to collect (Over 120 all)
18 hair colors to choose from 15 unique hairstyles
Eyebrows, lashes, eyes, mouth, and skin colors – we have you covered!
3 craftable crops with 7 colors to mix in your Sawing Machine
Over 60 hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Nintendo eShop:

Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.
A Fresh Start in CottonvilleAfter leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.
Customize Your CharacterExpress yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.
From Farming to FashionCultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.
Run Your AtelierTake charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.
Features:
60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
 Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!
Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!





IndieMania is the ultimate online event for indie game lovers. It’s a digital showcase of the best indie games from developers all around the world, featuring exclusive demos, interviews, live streams, and more. Whether you’re into action, adventure, puzzle, or simulation, you’ll find something to suit your taste at IndieMania. Join us in 2024 for our first online event and discover the hidden gems of the indie gaming scene. Don’t forget to subscribe to our channel and turn on the notifications to stay updated on the latest news and announcements. IndieMania: where indie games shine!
